name: One-Pot Rice & Grain Bowl
instructions: Toast rice or another grain briefly in a little oil before adding liquid -- it keeps the grains separate instead of gummy.
Cook the grain covered at a low simmer, resisting the urge to lift the lid, until the liquid is fully absorbed.
While the grain cooks, quickly saute or steam a vegetable and warm a protein in a separate small pan.
Assemble in bowls: grain as the base, protein and vegetables on top, finished with a simple dressing or sauce.
